content.text: All tests pass. But re-reviewing the code, I spotted a real bug: `open` doesn't reject when the same connection *ID* is already open at a different generation. Fixing:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('ebpf/helper.py').read()
# track open connection ids explicitly
old = """        self.connections = {}     # (id,gen) -> {'mark','pk'}
        self.conn_hw = {}         # id -> last open generation"""
new = """        self.connections = {}     # (id,gen) -> {'mark','pk'}
        self.conn_open = {}       # id -> generation while open
        self.conn_hw = {}         # id -> last open generation"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)

old = """    def op_open(self, e):
        cid, gen = e['connection']
        if (cid, gen) in self.connections or gen <= self.conn_hw.get(cid, 0):
            return REJECTED
        if self.n_conns >= self.limits['connections']:
            return REJECTED
        self.connections[(cid, gen)] = {'id': cid, 'gen': gen, 'mark': 0, 'pk': {}}
        self.conn_hw[cid] = gen
        self.n_conns += 1
        return OK"""
new = """    def op_open(self, e):
        cid, gen = e['connection']
        if cid in self.conn_open or gen <= self.conn_hw.get(cid, 0):
            return REJECTED
        if self.n_conns >= self.limits['connections']:
            return REJECTED
        self.connections[(cid, gen)] = {'id': cid, 'gen': gen, 'mark': 0, 'pk': {}}
        self.conn_open[cid] = gen
        self.conn_hw[cid] = gen
        self.n_conns += 1
        return OK"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)

old = """        del self.connections[(conn['id'], conn['gen'])]
        self.n_conns -= 1"""
new = """        del self.connections[(conn['id'], conn['gen'])]
        del self.conn_open[conn['id']]
        self.n_conns -= 1"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('ebpf/helper.py','w').write(src)
print("patched")
EOF
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('tests/test_edges.py').read()
old = '''expect("conn gen exhausted", ['''
new = '''expect("conn id open at other gen", [
    {"op": "open", "connection": [5, 1]},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [5, 2]},   # id 5 open at gen 1 -> reject
    {"op": "close", "connection": [5, 2]},  # wrong gen -> reject
    {"op": "close", "connection": [5, 1]},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [5, 2]},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [5, 3]},   # id 5 open at gen 2 -> reject
], [OK, REJ, REJ, OK, OK, REJ])

expect("conn gen exhausted", ['''
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
open('tests/test_edges.py','w').write(src)
EOF
